name: r1i_SprPkt
notes: store address folded differently: the original advances its packet write pointer (+0x20 +0x10 +8 ...) and stores at small offsets while modern cl addresses the same packet words from the base (same addresses)

name: r1i_RectPkt
notes: store address folded differently: the original advances its packet write pointer (+0x20 +0x10 +8 ...) and stores at small offsets while modern cl addresses the same packet words from the base (same addresses)

name: r1i_TrackLerp
notes: regargs: t=EAX; float precision: the original does the four colour byte lerps on the x87 stack (int times float plus int) before _ftol2 while modern cl uses SSE single precision (behaviour-test priority)

name: r1i_TrackStepA
notes: regargs: t=EDI; calls 0x00017F70 with EAX=t; constant 1.0f stored as an immediate by modern cl instead of a load from .rdata (same value)

name: r1i_TrackStepC
notes: regargs: t=EDI; calls 0x00017F70 with EAX=t; constant 1.0f stored as an immediate by modern cl instead of a load from .rdata (same value)

name: r1i_AimLimit
notes: regargs: o=EAX; float constant argument 0.1f pushed as an immediate by the original vs loaded from .rdata by modern cl (same value)

name: r1i_CamFollow
notes: calls 0x000192C0 with EDI=c; constant 1.0f stored as an immediate by modern cl instead of a load from .rdata (same value); the struct copy of view 1 is rep movsd in both

name: r1i_CamFrame
notes: constants 1.0f and 60.0f stored as immediates by modern cl instead of loads from .rdata (same values; both constants are still loaded for the compares); float precision: the original does the tilt products and the angle compare on the x87 stack (behaviour-test priority)

name: r1i_CamBlend
notes: bounds check 8<=state<=13 emitted as unsigned (state-8)<=5 by modern cl vs signed >=8 / <=13; constant 1.0f stored as an immediate by modern cl instead of from a register loaded from .rdata (same value)

name: r1i_BoxBuild
notes: float constants: 0.5f argument pushed as an immediate by the original vs loaded from .rdata by modern cl and 1.0f stored from .rdata by the original vs as an immediate by modern cl (same values); in the else branch d[0] is computed before the 0x001AD7C0 call (callee reads only the matrices) to stop modern cl merging the two multiply calls

name: r1i_BodyInit
notes: constant 1.0f stored as an immediate by modern cl instead of a load from .rdata (same value); the default hit handler is the empty debug stub 0x00102FA0

name: r1i_UnitsRelease
notes: constants 1.0f and 128.0f stored as immediates by modern cl instead of loads from .rdata (same values)

name: r1i_WipeDraw
notes: the original computes the bar steps in SSE single precision while modern cl uses the x87 stack here (behaviour-test priority)

name: r1i_HudOrbitDraw
notes: regargs: p=EAX; the -3.0 factor is read from its original .rdata slot 0x002602C0 through a symbol (a literal lets modern cl fold the sign into a subtraction) and the checker classifies the symbol by address and the original by value (same address and value); float constant argument 2*pi pushed as an immediate by the original vs loaded from .rdata by modern cl (same value)

name: r1i_HudSetup
notes: regargs: resume=EDI; constant -1.0f stored as an immediate by modern cl instead of a load from .rdata (same value)
